author: Claude
candidate_edge: H-V4: NY pre-open session-range breakout on USDJPY (primary) and EURUSD (secondary). Frozen 13213 mechanics on a 60-minute bar grid aligned to :30 server time: range = the N completed grid bars ending 15:30 server (= 08:30 America/New_York; N=2 -> arm C2 primary, N=3 -> arm C3 second frozen arm; EURUSD C3 only), buy stop at range high / sell stop at range low (OCO) at 15:30, SL = opposite edge (stop distance W), no TP, skip when W < 0.4 x ATR(14, same grid) or W > 2.5 x ATR, trail SL to the min/max of the last two completed grid bars once open profit >= 1.0 x initial risk, flat at 23:00 server (= 16:00 New York), framework Friday close 21:00 server and PRE30_POST30 high-impact news blackout unchanged. One position per symbol per day. Bounded integer/double inputs only; no ML.
confidence: Moderate. For USDJPY the claim rests on four legs: (1) the mechanism is already tester-qualified on the symbol (13213 through Q14), (2) the harness is calibrated against that tester result on the control cell (+1.8 % trades, +0.018R), (3) all nine USDJPY cells of the family are positive on the selection period and eight of nine survive the validation period, and (4) the C2/C3 cells have among the lowest chance-pass probabilities in the grid. The claim does NOT rest on a single p-value: cells of one symbol share days and ranges, the per-cell null is not a family-level test, and 314 cells were searched. Harness-to-tester optimism of ~+0.02R is expected, so the tester should print roughly +0.12R / PF ~1.25 for C2 if the harness is faithful; the pre-registered Q02 bar is +0.08R / PF 1.15. For EURUSD the evidence is thinner (single anchor, lower density 0.62/bd, SEL PF 1.18) and is treated as a secondary slot. Not modelled: real-tick intra-minute paths, spread and slippage (tester Model=4 handles both), the news blackout on exits/trailing.
confounders: Multiplicity: 314 cells were evaluated; 27 SEL passes vs 17.4 expected and 13 survivors vs 5.5 expected by the per-cell null. The per-cell bootstrap ignores the dependence between cells of one symbol (neighbouring N, overlapping anchors) and is therefore not a family-level test; a symbol-label permutation test is the stronger statement and has not been run (stated gap).

Same-symbol overlap with the incumbent QM5_13213 (Tokyo window): the NY pre-open trade often follows a Tokyo-range trade on the same day; H-V4 is a candidate REPLACEMENT/upgrade of 13213's window rather than an additional independent sleeve unless the daily-P/L correlation with 13213 measures below 0.5 at Q08 (pre-registered tail test).

Harness optimism: zero-spread, zero-slippage fills at the level and 18 simulation-only days on the control cell put the harness ~+0.02R above the tester; the Q02 bar is set below the harness figure accordingly.

News blackout overlap: the 08:30 New York anchor coincides with the densest US high-impact release slot; the harness models PRE30_POST30 only at the placement tick (280 delayed / 91 blocked placement days over 2018-25 for USDJPY C2). The tester's full news handling may remove or shift more trades than modelled.

Regime: 2021-2022 (JPY depreciation, Fed hiking) contribute 90.6R of the 141.1R SEL net for USDJPY C2 (2018 +24.8, 2019 +12.0, 2020 +13.7, 2021 +51.8, 2022 +38.8), and 2024 contributes 59.2R of the 91.0R VAL net; every SEL and VAL year is nevertheless positive.
Friday close: 92 of the 998 SEL trades exit at the framework Friday close (21:00 server) before the 23:00 flat; a different Friday policy changes the numbers.
observations: Pre-registered sweep (registration committed before the run: docs/research/velocity/VELOCITY_FAMILY_F1_SESSION_RANGE_SWEEP_2026-09-21.md @ 60de323f25; results @ 270c9a4c98) over 36 symbols x 3 anchors x N in {2,3,4} hours = 314 cells with trades on .DWX M1 custom history, closed-bar M1 simulation (stop fills at the level on the touching M1 bar, both edges in one bar = full loss), registry commission, .DWX spread 0. Control cell USDJPY A3 reproduces the tester Q02 of the byte-identical 13213 lineage (work item 652e0768) within +1.8 % trades and +0.018R (harness systematically ~+0.02R optimistic: zero spread/slippage fills, 18 simulation-only days). Selection 2018-07-02..2022-12-30, validation 2023-01-02..2025-12-31, floor/cap and rule frozen before the run. 27 of 314 cells pass the SEL rule (17.4 expected by the per-cell centred block-bootstrap null), 13 survive VAL confirmation (5.5 expected), all 13 family-consistent. USDJPY: 9/9 cells SEL-positive, 8/9 survivors (B2 fails VAL at -0.0006R); C2 is the best cell in the whole grid (SEL n=998, 0.85/bd, +0.141R, PF 1.302, worst-year DD 20.8R, +0.120 R/bd; VAL n=632, 0.81/bd, +0.144R, PF 1.295, DD 25.0R, +0.116 R/bd; chance-pass probability joint 0.0135). EURUSD: A and B anchors negative on SEL (all six cells), C2/C3/C4 positive on SEL and VAL; C2 fails only the 25R DD bar (27.5R), C3 and C4 are survivors. Indices, EUR/CHF/CAD crosses, AUDNZD, GBPNZD negative everywhere; XAUUSD C cells positive only in 2023-25 (not selectable).
proposed_mechanism: USDJPY's intraday information flow is concentrated around the 08:30 New York macro-release / pre-open hour (US data prints, Treasury-yield repricing, the JPY carry-book adjustment into the US session). A completed 2-3 hour range immediately before that anchor bounds the pre-release consolidation; a stop-order breakout of that range at the anchor converts the release into a directional trade with a stop equal to the range width and no fixed target, exactly the risk geometry that already qualified on USDJPY at the Tokyo window (QM5_13213, Q02..Q14). The sweep shows the anchor, not the mechanism, was the limiting factor: every USDJPY cell of the family is positive on the selection period (9/9), and the NY pre-open cells roughly double R per business day at equal density. On EURUSD the same NY anchor is the ONLY positive anchor (A and B cells are all negative on SEL), consistent with the pair's US-session macro sensitivity rather than a London-open microstructure effect (the H-V1 result).
